#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p "/tmp/T1/wan_i2v_720p_nocache/a_man_and_a_child_riding_bumper_cars_in_an_amusement_park" "/home/ubuntu/stage1_cache"
cd /home/ubuntu/repo/SuperGen
PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \
/home/ubuntu/envs/easycache/bin/torchrun --nproc_per_node=$(echo 0,1,2,3 | tr ',' '\n' | wc -l) \
  --master_port 34017 WanI2V/pipeline.py \
  --prompt "a man and a child riding bumper cars in an amusement park" --image_path "/home/ubuntu/repo/UltraGen-PPoPP-experiments/inputs/2k_1440x2560/a man and a child riding bumper cars in an amusement park.jpg" \
  --ckpt_dir /home/ubuntu/ckpts/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P \
  --width 1280 --height 720 --upscale_factor 1 \
  --num_frames 41 --num_inference_steps 50 --upscale_res_steps 35 --seed 0 \
  --output_path "/tmp/T1/wan_i2v_720p_nocache/a_man_and_a_child_riding_bumper_cars_in_an_amusement_park/out.mp4" --stage1_latents_path "/home/ubuntu/stage1_cache/wan_i2v_720p_a_man_and_a_child_riding_bumper_cars_in_an_amusement_park.pt" --rope_mode local \
  --loop_step 16 \
   > "/tmp/T1/wan_i2v_720p_nocache/a_man_and_a_child_riding_bumper_cars_in_an_amusement_park/run_log.log" 2>&1
rc=$?; echo "exit=$rc" >> "/tmp/T1/wan_i2v_720p_nocache/a_man_and_a_child_riding_bumper_cars_in_an_amusement_park/run_log.log"; exit $rc
